description: Make an earlier version of a hosted drop live again, on the same URL. Use when an update broke the page. Get version numbers from list_versions. pin=true keeps that version live even when new versions are published (e.g. the client approved v3 while you keep iterating); unpin=true (no version needed) puts the latest version back live.

space.description: The owner's handle, when acting on a drop someone shared with you.
